text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I barely even wore them, and my legs are already wobbling!
Heels are tough work, man...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Before heading to the next shop,
maybe I should take a break at a grown-up kind of place~??

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah! This ice cream looks delish☆
The toppings are super cute too, let's pick this cafe!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Welcome! That ice cream is
super popular with the kids~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... No thank you!
It looks yummy, but Maya isn't a kid!

Mayano Top Gun ended up
falling into a bad mood...
